captured_from: A real SubagentStop payload for a named agent from Claude Code 2.1.280, captured 2026-09-29 by the same raw dump hook, in the same scratch project under d:\pantesting, that captured subagent-stop-internal-claude.json. A headless `claude -p --permission-mode default` turn started one Explore subagent. The keys, their order and their value types are the captured ones, and so are the relations between values: agent_transcript_path was the standard `<parent dir>/<session_id>/subagents/agent-<agent_id>.jsonl`, and that file and its .meta.json existed when the hook ran; background_tasks listed the stopping agent itself, with the same id and agent_type, type `subagent` and status `running`. The values are synthetic: the agent is renamed pan-executor, and the ids, the paths, the task description and the 567-character final report are replaced. `permission_mode` keeps the captured value. The previous version of this fixture (2026-09-17) was derived from the fields the hooks read and lacked seven keys the host sends: scratchpad_dir, prompt_id, permission_mode, agent_transcript_path, last_assistant_message, background_tasks and session_crons.

placeholders.{{SESSION_ID}}: the host session id; the test substitutes a synthetic one that also names the subagents/ directory
placeholders.{{TRANSCRIPT_PATH}}: absolute path of the PARENT session transcript the host hands the hook
placeholders.{{PROJECT_DIR}}: absolute path of the project the hook writes its ledger row into
placeholders.{{SCRATCHPAD_DIR}}: the host's per-session scratchpad directory; no PAN hook reads it
placeholders.{{AGENT_ID}}: the host's per-spawn agent id, 17 lowercase hex characters in the capture; it resolves <parent dir>/<session_id>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl and is also the id of the agent's background_tasks entry
placeholders.{{AGENT_TRANSCRIPT_PATH}}: the subagent's own transcript, named by the host; the hooks use it over the path derived from agent_id whenever the file exists

notes: `usage` is not in the capture: the turn ran headless, where docs/HOOKS.md records the field as absent. It is kept from the 2026-09-17 version and placed last, because its position has never been captured. It is deliberately implausible (a cumulative session counter, which docs/HOOKS.md records the host sending on this event): the agent transcript in subagent-transcripts-claude.json holds the true per-spawn counts, so a row built from `usage` instead of the agent transcript is visibly wrong rather than merely different. Omitted because no capture carries them: `model`, `phase`, `command`, `exit_code`. The helper-agent payload in subagent-stop-internal-claude.json has the same keys in the same order; there agent_type is empty and the named transcript is never written.
